title: Catalog Fulfillment Method
description: Method-first availability for a product variant in catalog responses. Catalog expresses possibilities and recommendations, not checkout selections.

type.description: Fulfillment method type. Capability version bumps may extend this enum with additional protocol-blessed method types.

availability.description: Availability summary for this method under the applied catalog context.

description.description: Buyer-facing summary, such as 'Pickup available today at Downtown Store'.

destinations.description: Buyer-visible destinations for location-bound methods. Shipping methods SHOULD omit destinations unless the destination is buyer-provided and visible.
